items.title: Adyen co-CEO Pieter van der Does to retire at year-end; Uytdehaage to take helm
items.summary: Investing.com -- Adyen NV (AS:ADYEN) announced after European trading hours on Monday that co-founder Pieter van der Does will retire as co-chief executive officer at the end of the year, concluding a multi-year leadership succession plan. Ingo Uytdehaage, who has served alongside van der Does as co-CEO since 2023, will assume sole leadership of the Amsterdam-based payments processor effective January 1, 2027.

items.title: PayPal’s Greg Archibald: Checkout Becomes More Valuable in the Age of AI Agents
items.summary: RANCHO PALOS VERDES, CALIF. — When an AI agent does the shopping, someone still has to stand behind the purchase. Consumers handing that task to a machine want to know the transaction was secure, the shopper was protected, and the merchant is real. Greg Archibald, vp of global ad sales at PayPal, thinks that need makes the checkout moment more valuable, not less. He sees it playing to the strengths of a payments platform that sits between consumers and merchants.
